Q: Is there a way to speed up signtool? It is slow A:

Use Sign from Microsoft Foundation. Final version has not been released yet but it works very well.

Sign can be used to sign files with the following certificate sources:

  • Local certificate file

  • Windows Certificate Store

  • Azure Key Vault

  • Azure Artifact Signing

It is available via NuGet and you can install with the following dotnet command (--prerelease is necessary until final version be released):

dotnet tool install -g --prerelease sign

After installing you can view help typing the following command:

sign code --help

Q: Trying to send SMS to USA A:

Error 21612 typically indicates that the selected From number cannot send messages to the destination To number because of Twilio restrictions or carrier regulations.

In this case, you're attempting to send SMS from an Irish (+353) long code to U.S. (+1) recipients. U.S. carriers have specific compliance requirements for application-to-person (A2P) messaging, so an international long code generally cannot be used for business messaging to U.S. numbers.

To send SMS to U.S. recipients, you should:

  • Purchase a U.S. (+1) Twilio phone number.

  • Complete Brand Registration in Twilio Trust Hub.

  • Register an A2P 10DLC campaign that matches your messaging use case (for example, Customer Care or Marketing).

  • Associate your U.S. phone number or Messaging Service with the approved campaign before sending messages.

If your application serves both Ireland and the U.S., using separate sender numbers for each country is generally the recommended approach. It complies with carrier requirements, improves deliverability, and provides a better experience for recipients.

Q: Convert HTML to PDF or PNG without headeless browser instance in NodeJS A:

I had the same problem and ended up implementing a different approach.

Instead of running Chromium, this uses PDFKit as the rendering backend.

It is not a full browser replacement (complex CSS/layout may still require Chromium), but for server-side documents like invoices/reports it significantly reduces startup time and memory usage.

Source:
https://github.com/BohdanShtelmakh/html-to-pdf
https://www.npmjs.com/package/html-pdf-lite

Would appreciate any feedback, especially regarding edge cases.

Q: Excel: Can I create a Formula based on the Color of a Cell? A:

Try this macro, then run it against the filled cells. It will create a numerical value in the column to the left which you could then hide at the end of the macro.

Sub ListColors()

For Each c In Selection 

    c.Offset(0, 1).Value = c.Interior.Color 

Next c 

End Sub

You could then run any formulas against that numerical value.
